'''Ralltiiri Colonials''' were the local currency of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], in use around the time of the<ref name="LP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080409/index.html|text="Labor Pains"|int=Labor Pains|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> They could be exchanged for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at most places.<ref name="LP" />
